fuzz.KXETHD-26NOV0118-T1449.99.v2.resolv.instructions:
Take the documents under OBSERVED to be the evidence available at expiration. Applying the contract rules that follow, does the contract resolve YES or NO, or do the rules together with the evidence leave it ambiguous?
The contract rules are:
Underlying and definitions
The Underlying is the spot price of one Ether (ETH) in U.S. dollars (USD) at a given time. CF Benchmarks documents it as the simple average of the CF Ethereum Real-Time Index (ERTI) over the minute (60 seconds) before that time. It is published in USD to a precision of $0.01. In this contract, the "Price" means this value for the time 2026-11-01 23:00:00 UTC, which is 6:00:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (America/New_York) on November 1, 2026. The averaging window is the 60 seconds ending at that time. The terms do not say whether the window's endpoints are included or excluded, so CF Benchmarks' documentation of the index decides this. The "Strike" is $1,449.99.

Source hierarchy and conflict rule
There is one Source Agency: CF Benchmarks, which publishes the CF Ethereum Real-Time Index at https://www.cfbenchmarks.com/data/indices/ETHUSD_RTI. It is ranked first and is the only source. The conflict rule is to take the value from the highest-ranked source that has one available. Because CF Benchmarks is the only source, sources cannot disagree. If CF Benchmarks has no value available, the Price cannot be established, and the Unknown at expiry rule applies.

Trigger
The contract resolves Yes if the Price is strictly greater than $1,449.99. The Price is the simple average of the ERTI over the 60 seconds before 2026-11-01 23:00:00 UTC (6:00:00 PM EST, America/New_York, November 1, 2026), at its published precision of $0.01. The condition is checked once, for that single time. A Price of exactly $1,449.99 does not meet it. Otherwise, the contract resolves No. A Yes contract pays $1.00 in USD and a No contract pays nothing. Payout amounts are rounded to the nearest $0.01, with exact halves rounded to the even cent.

Timing
All times are given in UTC, with Eastern Standard Time (America/New_York) in brackets. Trading opens at 2026-11-01 22:00:00 UTC (5:00:00 PM EST, November 1, 2026). Trading closes at 2026-11-01 23:00:00 UTC (6:00:00 PM EST, November 1, 2026), which is also the time the Price is measured for. Expiration is 2026-11-08 23:00:00 UTC (6:00:00 PM EST, November 8, 2026). The observation cutoff is the same time: a value of the Underlying must be available by then to count. Settlement takes place one calendar day after expiration. Payment is made at settlement, with no further lag (0 days). The contract has no early expiration.

Unknown at expiry
If the Price cannot be established by expiration (2026-11-08 23:00:00 UTC, 6:00:00 PM EST), the contract resolves No. There is no extension.

Revisions
The Price used for settlement is the value as published at expiration (2026-11-08 23:00:00 UTC, 6:00:00 PM EST). Any revision CF Benchmarks publishes after expiration does not affect the outcome.
Answer from the state alone. Rely on what is under OBSERVED; treat what is under ASSUMED as hypothetical, given only for this question. If the state does not establish the answer, choose the answer that says so.
